paper.title_en: Spectral Fingerprints Beyond Degeneracies in Primordial Gravitational-Wave Sources
paper.abstract_en: Stochastic gravitational-wave backgrounds from different primordial mechanisms can exhibit identical peak frequencies and amplitudes, leaving their origin degenerate. We show that this degeneracy can be broken by the broadband spectral response of the gravitational-wave source. By comparing scalar-induced and gauge-field-induced gravitational waves with the same primordial spectral profile and cosmological evolution, we isolate the imprint of the tensor-source dynamics. Although both mechanisms exhibit the same infrared scaling, they develop distinct spectral shapes near the peak and different ultraviolet asymptotes. The local spectral index $n_{\rm gw}$ and its running $α_{\rm gw}$ further characterize this source-dependent evolution, providing a spectral fingerprint beyond the peak observables. These results show that broadband, multi-frequency observations can probe the production mechanism of a primordial gravitational-wave background even when its peak frequency and amplitude are degenerate.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文讨论原初机制产生的随机引力波背景的谱特征，提出通过宽带谱响应（局部谱指数 n_gw 及其跑动 α_gw）打破峰值频率与振幅的简并，直接关联脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）所观测的随机引力波背景的起源识别问题，理论深度与新颖性较好，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 超越简并的原初引力波源谱指纹
decision.abstract_zh: 来自不同原初机制的随机引力波背景可能呈现相同的峰值频率和振幅，从而使其起源发生简并。我们表明，这种简并可以通过引力波源的宽带谱响应被打破。通过比较具有相同原初谱形和宇宙学演化的标量诱导引力波与规范场诱导引力波，我们分离出张量源动力学的印记。尽管两种机制表现出相同的红外标度，但它们在峰值附近形成不同的谱形，并具有不同的紫外渐近行为。局部谱指数 $n_{\rm gw}$ 及其跑动 $\alpha_{\rm gw}$ 进一步刻画了这种依赖于源的演化，提供了超越峰值可观测量的谱指纹。这些结果表明，即使原初引力波背景的峰值频率和振幅是简并的，宽带、多频观测也能够探测其产生机制。
